question: Identify the artist with the highest overall sales of albums (tie broken by alphabetical order) and the artist with the lowest overall sales of albums (tie broken by alphabetical order), then calculate the amount each customer spent specifically on those two artists’ albums. Next, compute the average spending for the customers who purchased from the top-selling artist and the average spending for the customers who purchased from the lowest-selling artist, and finally return the absolute difference between these two averages.
sql:
-- Final: Compute absolute difference between the two averages
WITH top_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName, TotalSales
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            a.ArtistId,
            ar.Name AS ArtistName,
            SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS TotalSales
        FROM artists ar
        JOIN albums a ON ar.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
        JOIN tracks t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
        JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
        GROUP BY a.ArtistId, ar.Name
        ORDER BY TotalSales DESC, ar.Name ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )
),
lowest_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName, TotalSales
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            a.ArtistId,
            ar.Name AS ArtistName,
            SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS TotalSales
        FROM artists ar
        JOIN albums a ON ar.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
        JOIN tracks t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
        JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
        GROUP BY a.ArtistId, ar.Name
        ORDER BY TotalSales ASC, ar.Name ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )
),
top_customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        inv.CustomerId,
        SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS customer_spending
    FROM invoice_items ii
    JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
    JOIN invoices inv ON ii.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
    JOIN top_artist ta ON a.ArtistId = ta.ArtistId
    GROUP BY inv.CustomerId
),
lowest_customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        inv.CustomerId,
        SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS customer_spending
    FROM invoice_items ii
    JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
    JOIN invoices inv ON ii.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
    JOIN lowest_artist la ON a.ArtistId = la.ArtistId
    GROUP BY inv.CustomerId
),
top_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(customer_spending) AS avg_spending FROM top_customer_spending
),
lowest_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(customer_spending) AS avg_spending FROM lowest_customer_spending
)
SELECT ABS(t.avg_spending - l.avg_spending) AS absolute_difference
FROM top_avg t, lowest_avg l
